Retrieved guidance applied: Card-not-present fraud: the card number is used online without the card, with amounts and products that do not fit the cardholder's history, often a burst of two to four within 48 hours. One unusual online purchase alone is ambiguous and should be verified.

case.summary: The customer reported a $30.02 purchase they said they did not make. Review of the card showed the same $30.02 charge on four earlier dates, indicating a recurring purchase. The device profile is already known on this card and does not suggest fraud. The customer confirmed the charge was theirs after seeing the earlier identical transactions, so the case was closed as legitimate. The customer was warned about the recurring charge and the case was closed with no fraud action taken.
